title: Construct the selected complex stopping cutoff from Gamma headers with paid unary arithmetic and preserved caller tapes
body:
## Result
Produce C=min(ceil(d^(1/Q)),e+1), Q=10^14, directly from Gamma(p)Gamma(d) on an eleven-tape literal program; link it to the unchanged rank-one controller and retire every private marker.

## Novelty and predecessors
The selected epsilon=1-1/Q makes paid unary preparation O(h+d*C)=O(p), including head returns, erasures and historical unary-d backing. The stopping exponent differs from the outer exponent.

## Verification
357 author cases plus 117 independent dense-CPU cases, proof/cost review and mutations. Run python3 -B research/selected-header-cutoff/verify.py.

## Limits and kappa
Valid header and post-reservation WIDTH are inputs; no final grants/payload. No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors and PRs as detailed in the package.

Full proof, reproducibility, negative controls and provenance: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/da3f01ded52e84388d9b40b70590dd4dce6f51b4/research/selected-header-cutoff
